answer: Work waits on the pulse until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the oasis of the next round. The velvet of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on time-locked escrow with arbitration fallback. Written in a pragmatic engineering perspective, trade-offs first register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
